book: A Latin theological disputation of 1673 on 1 Cor. 10:15-17 (the Lord's Supper), in one work, with a title page, dedicatory matter and invocation, then 23 numbered theses, each with questions, a closing section of 17 numbered documenta, and a final dedicatory poem and motto.
